key: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
en: The Key reacted to the Crystal!
ja: カギがクリスタルに反応した!

key: LUNA: Please, do not succumb to imagination.
en: LUNA: Please, do not succumb to imagination.
ja: ルナ: どうか、想像にのまれないでください。

key: This is something you can do.
en: This is something you can do.
ja: あなたにはできることです。

key: Shall we begin?
en: Shall we begin?
ja: 始めましょうか?

key: LUNA: He has left, right?
en: LUNA: He has left, right?
ja: ルナ: 彼はもう去りましたね?

key: Very well.
en: Very well.
ja: それでは。

key: Let us try this once more.
en: Let us try this once more.
ja: もう一度、試みましょう。

key: Welcome, \PN. I am glad you were able to reach me here.
en: Welcome, \PN. I am glad you were able to reach me here.
ja: ようこそ、\PN。ここまでたどり着けたこと、うれしく思います。

key: Children, and even some adults, are scared of the darkness.
en: Children, and even some adults, are scared of the darkness.
ja: 子供たち、そして大人の中にも、闇を恐れる人がいます。

key: Why is that, I wonder?
en: Why is that, I wonder?
ja: それはなぜなのでしょうか。

key: Is it because they think that awful and sinister things come here to dwell?
en: Is it because they think that awful and sinister things come here to dwell?
ja: 恐ろしく邪悪なものがここに住みつくと思うからでしょうか?

key: There are too many of those in the light for that to be true.
en: There are too many of those in the light for that to be true.
ja: それが真実だとすれば、光の中にもそういうものは多すぎるほどです。

key: Or perhaps they are simply afraid of their own imaginations.
en: Or perhaps they are simply afraid of their own imaginations.
ja: あるいは、単に自分自身の想像を恐れているだけなのかもしれません。

key: Darkness is that which draws out the greatest potential, but for some, infinity can be a terrifying abyss.
en: Darkness is that which draws out the greatest potential, but for some, infinity can be a terrifying abyss.
ja: 闇とは、最大の可能性を引き出すものです。ですが、ある者にとっては、無限とは恐ろしい奈落にもなり得ます。

key: Please, allow me to introduce you to an infinity, lost.
en: Please, allow me to introduce you to an infinity, lost.
ja: どうか、失われた無限というものを、あなたにご紹介させてください。

key: Scattered and fractured, it shall return piece by piece.
en: Scattered and fractured, it shall return piece by piece.
ja: 散らばり砕けたそれは、少しずつ戻ってくることでしょう。

key: Are you ready?
en: Are you ready?
ja: 準備はよろしいですか?

key: You have overcome the gateway into the soul of eternity... Though its beauty is tarnished, your soul shines with hope. I pray you farewell.
en: You have overcome the gateway into the soul of eternity... Though its beauty is tarnished, your soul shines with hope. I pray you farewell.
ja: あなたは　永遠の魂へ続く門を　越えたのね……その美しさは　曇っていても　あなたの魂は　希望に輝いている。どうか　よい旅を

key: LUNA: You fought especially well.
en: LUNA: You fought especially well.
ja: ルナ: 特に見事な戦いぶりでした。

key: I expected no less.
en: I expected no less.
ja: それだけの期待はしていましたが。

key: Now, I may present this to you.
en: Now, I may present this to you.
ja: それでは、これをあなたに授けましょう。

key: \PN received the Eclipse Badge!
en: \PN received the Eclipse Badge!
ja: \PNはエクリプスバッジを手に入れた!

key: LUNA: With the Eclipse Badge, Pokémon up to level 70 will trust you. Please treat them well.
en: LUNA: With the Eclipse Badge, Pokémon up to level 70 will trust you. Please treat them well.
ja: ルナ: エクリプスバッジがあれば、レベル70までのポケモンがあなたを信頼します。どうか大切にしてあげてください。

key: Finally, I have one last gift for you.
en: Finally, I have one last gift for you.
ja: 最後に、もう一つ贈り物があります。

key: Please use darkness' embrace as you see fit.
en: Please use darkness' embrace as you see fit.
ja: 闇の抱擁を、あなたの思うままにお使いください。

key: I shall be remaining here for a time.
en: I shall be remaining here for a time.
ja: わたしはしばらくここに残るつもりです。

key: I feel that I, like all the monsters of which children fear, shall be safer in the dark.
en: I feel that I, like all the monsters of which children fear, shall be safer in the dark.
ja: 子供たちが恐れるあらゆる怪物たちと同じように、わたしも闇の中の方が安全だと感じるのです。

key: As for you, did your friend not say that he would move towards Agate City?
en: As for you, did your friend not say that he would move towards Agate City?
ja: あなたはどうです、お友達はアゲートシティへ向かうと言っていませんでしたか?

key: I know not what dreams mesmerize the station guards, but perhaps it is time for you to discover that for yourself.
en: I know not what dreams mesmerize the station guards, but perhaps it is time for you to discover that for yourself.
ja: 駅の見張りたちがどんな夢に魅入られているのか、わたしは存じませんが、そろそろあなた自身の目で確かめる時なのかもしれません。

key: I do hope we meet again someday.
en: I do hope we meet again someday.
ja: いつかまたお会いできることを願っています。

key: Until then, farewell.
en: Until then, farewell.
ja: それまで、さようなら。

key: LUNA: Did your friend not say that he would move towards Agate City?
en: LUNA: Did your friend not say that he would move towards Agate City?
ja: ルナ: お友達はアゲートシティへ向かうと言っていませんでしたか?
